speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates
speckit.author: GitHub

saas-feature.name: SaaS Feature Delivery Cycle
saas-feature.description: Production-grade feature delivery: scope → RFC → schema → DAL → services → API → UI → E2E → quality gates → verify → progressive rollout → observability. Tool commands are inputs — adapts to any Next.js/TS SaaS.
saas-feature.author: satcom

hotfix.name: Hotfix Delivery
hotfix.description: Fast-path bug fix: scope → implement → regression test → quality gates → verify → staging → prod with mandatory gate and blameless postmortem. Skips RFC and feature-flag ceremony.
hotfix.author: satcom

migration-only.name: DB Migration Delivery
migration-only.description: Safe path for schema-only changes with explicit expand-contract phases: scope → SQL review gate → apply local → quality gates → migration record → staging verify → prod-gate (DEPLOY confirm) → post-deploy verify.
migration-only.author: satcom
